summary.text: Mamie E. Locke is a Democratic member of the Virginia Senate, representing District 23, which covers all of Hampton City and parts of Newport News City, and has served in the Senate since 2004.
Locke sits on the Senate committees on Rules; Commerce and Labor; Education and Health; Finance and Appropriations; and General Laws and Technology, and chairs Rules.

paragraphs.text: Mamie E. Locke was born in Brandon, Mississippi on March 19, 1954, according to the Senate profile.

The profile lists Locke's education as Tougaloo College (B.A.); Atlanta University (M.A., Ph.D); Certificate in Management Development, Harvard University; and Certificate in Archives Administration, Emory University/Georgia Department of Archives and History.
The profile gives Locke's occupation as professor emeritus of political science at Hampton University.

Memberships and affiliations listed on the profile include Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Inc., life member; Links, Incorporated; Transitions (Family Violence Services), board member; NAACP, subscribing gold member and former executive board member; TowneBank, former board member.

Listed awards include Fulbright Hays Award, American University in Cairo; Outstanding Public Service Award, Conference of Minority Public Administrators; Martin Luther King Memorial Award, Old Dominion University; Lawrence Bethel Woman of Courage Award, 100 Black Men of America.
